book.name: Matei
book.title: Lijambu la Amboni ngati ejuandiki Matei

content: Majetangane guku nkoma Yesu
Yesu pajajomula kupwaga haga goti, jaapwagila banafunzi baki,
“Mmanyiki egipeta masoba mabeli gibiya tipati ja Pasaka, Mwana waka Mundu bankamula ili bumbambaliya pu nsalaba.”
Masoba ge haga agolu akolongu na aseja ba bandu baketangana pamu pa sengu jaka Kayafa, jojabii nngolu nkolongu.
Bataputa indela juu ujanza juku nkamu Yesu nunkukoma.
Lakini baamua lijambu lee liihengeka lisoba la tipati ja Pasaka, ili bandu biileta puju.
Yesu bumpaki mauta gaganungi ku Betania
Yesu pajwabii ku Betania, mu nyumba jaka Simoni joandamisa ugonzu ukuleleka,
mmbomba jumu anhikila koni jutogwi lisupa lealenganisi kwi lilibu lebilikema alabasita lelatweli mahuta gaganungali gabei ngolongu, anzitila Yesu kumutu pajabiya jukula posu.
Banafunzi baki ebabona hela basuki nukupwaga, “Ndaba ja kii kuhoa mahuta hela?
Mahuta ge haga bakalombisa kwa bei ngolongo, lupija lwe bakaapekia aka kapuku.”
Yesu jagamanyiki mawasu gabu jaapwajila, “Ndaba jakii munsumbu nyongo jonzo? Jombi juhengiki lijambu la amboni ngamaa.
Aka kapuku mmbinaku masoba goha lakini ngamwikubi na nepani masoba goha.
Nyongo ajo pajanyegi mahuta gaganungi jabiya juandaa nhyega jango ndaba jukujitaga.
Numpwagi sakaka, pokapi pundema pabiilandila Lijambu la Amboni, sejuhengiki nyongo jonzo biilandila sukunkomboka jombi.”
Yuda jujetake kung'alambuka Yesu
Ndienu jumu ja banafunzi komi na abeli jobukema Yuda Isikalioti, jajenda kwaka agolu akolongu,
jaapwagila, “Mwimbekia sindu boo nanung'anambwiki Yesu?” Bumbalangiya mangengalema makomi matatu gu lupija nukumpeke.
Tumbuka pala, Yuda jabiya jutaputa mbekenyu jukunng'anambuka Yesu.
Yesu jukula posu ja tipati ja Pasaka na banafunzi baki
Lisoba lukutumbuli la tipati ga mabumunda ganga kujege amila, banafunzi bunzendila Yesu nukupwagi, “Boo gupala tukuguhandaliya kwako posu ja Pasaka?”
Jombi japwaga, “Nnzendaniya ku musi kwaka mundu jumu mwanalomi mukupwagila, ‘Mbola jupwaga masoba gangu gahegalii. Nepani na banafunzi bangu twikula posu ja Pasaka mu nyumba jaku.’ ”
Ndienu banafunzi bahenga ngati Yesu ejaapwagila, na bombi baandia posu jakula Pasaka.
Ekwahika pakamii, Yesu jakula posu pamu na banafunzi baki komi na abeli.
Pababia bakakula, Yesu japwaaga, “Numpwagi sakaka jumu wi jwiindenda kung'anambuka.”
Banafunzi baki gwaabiniki mwoju ngamaa, kila mundu jatumbuliya kundaluki Yesu, “Boo, Bambu, nepane lena?”
Yesu jaapwajila, “Jojutobe libumunda laki pamu na nepani mmbakuli ndi jojing'anumbuka.
Mwana waka Mundu jujenda kuwa, ngati eahandiki mu Maandiku gaka Sapanga. Lakini musijikiboni mundu joang'anumbuka Mwana waka Mundu! Kwiibiya mbanga mundu hoju ejakasindiki kusaliwa.”
Yuda, ndi jojapala kunng'anumbuka andalukiya, “Mbola, boo, nepane?” Yesu jajibua, “Weapa gupwajiki.”
Posu jaka Bambu
Pababiya bakakula, Yesu jwajukua libumunda, ansengula Sapanga, jamega, jaapekia banafunzi baki japwaga, “Nnzukua mkula, jenze nhyega jango.”
Ndipala jajukua nnzipuli wa divai ja zabibu jwasengula, jaapekia koni jupwaga, “Nkunywa mwaboa.
Gongo mwai wango wa malagano gogujitika ndaba jakulekake bandu bingi ili alekakiwa mahakau.
Numpwaji ngangunywi kabee divai ja zabibu mbaka lisoba paniikunywa divai inyai pamu nu mbanganya mu Ukolongu wa Atati bango.”
Ebajomula kujemba nhwambu gu ulumbi, jaboka jajenda ku Kitombi si Mizeituni.
Yesu julote Petili jwiitenda kunkana
Ndienu Yesu jaapwajila, “Ikilu ja lelenu, kila mundu musijundenda kundila nukuneka ngati Maandiku gaka Sapanga egapwaga, ‘Nandapula nndimi, nu nsambi wa makondoo wiitenda kupesangana.’
Lakini eniiyoka, nandonguliya kujenda ku Galilaya.”
Petili apwagila Yesu, “Hata ngati boka baguleka weapa, nepani nganuguleki.”
Yesu ampwagila, “Nugupwagi sakaka, ikilu jenze kabula ji likongobi kubeka wingana mala pa tato.”
Petili apwagila, “Nganugukane hata nakupalika kuwa pamu naweapa.” Na banafunzi bangi boti bapwaga ahelahela.
Yesu juloba pandu pabapakema Getisemani
Ndipala Yesu jajenda pamu na banafunzi baki pandu pabapakema Getisemani, jaapwajila, “Ntamaniya pamba nane nyenda palapa kundoba Sapanga.”
Anzukua Petili pamu na bana abeli baka Zebedayu bala, jatumbuliya kuhangajika nukumbina mwoju.
Papuje japwaaga, “Mwoju wangu gubi nuusungu ngamaa gukuegale kuwa. Ntamaniya kelukelu pamu nanepane.”
Jajenda palongi kidogu, jahabuka ukupama nukundoba Sapanga, “Atati bangu, ana kuwesikana, mokia nzipuli ukung'alika gongo kuhuma kwango. Lakini nga ngati embala nepani ila ngati egupala weapa.”
Ndipala ejwaakelubukiya banafunzi baki, jwaaketaniya agoni. Andalukiya Petili, “Boo ngasemwawesiki kukeluki pamu nanepani hata lisaa limo?
Ntama na nndoba ili mwijingi mu milengu. Loho jipala lakini nhyega ngase jibii namakili.”
Yesu jajenda kabee, jaloba, “Atati bangu, ana kuwesakini nnzipuli gukung'alika gongo gumbeta kutali bila kunywa, ila gagupala weapa gahengika.”
Pajakelubuka kabee, jaakolila agoni ndaba mihu gabu gabi nulugonu.
Yesu jaaleka, jajenda kabee kuloba mala ja tatu, jaloba kabee ahelahela.
Ndienu jaajendila banafunzi nakapwaji, “Boo, mwakona nngoni nukupomulela? Nndinga muda guhikiki na Mwana waka Mundu bumpeleka kwa bandu bana mahakau.
Nnzemaniya, tumbokaniya. Nndingaliya, juhika jola jojing'alumbuka.”
Yesu buntenda kunkamu
Yesu pajabiya jakalongila nabu, Yuda jumu ja banafunzi komi na abeli bala, jahika na bandu bingi baatogwi mapanga na ibonga babube babiya ahikiki sukutumwa na agolu akolongu na aseja babandu.
Yuda jabiya jaapeki nginyuli jukupwaga, “Mundu jonukukumbatiya jola ndi jombi, mukunkamula.”
Yuda anzendila Yesu nukupwagi, “Jambu otii Mbola!” Ndi jwatenda kukumbati.

content.text: Papuje bandu bala bunhegaliya Yesu nukunkamu nukumbeka pai juulonda wabu.
Jumu ja bandu bababi pamu na Yesu bala jahopula upanga waki andapula ntumisi wa agolu akolongu, nukunseku likutu.
Yesu ampwagila, “Kelubua upanga waku munhaku waki. Ndaba jokapi jojukoma kupete upanga jiikuwa nuupanga.
Uhambusi ngasenhwesa kwaaloba Atati bangu anetila hikundi ya alonda komi na abele ba atumisi bu kunani ahika kunyangatila?
Lakini giitimia boo Maandiku gaka Sapanga ganga gagapwaga majambu ge haga kupalika gapitila?”

content: Apalapa Yesu jugupwajila nsambi wa bandu bala, “Boo, nhikiki kungamu kwa mapanga niibonga nepani ngati lee jojuhalabana malagalaki gaka Sapanga? Kila lisoba nabii pamu numbanganya pa Nyumba jaka Sapanga nakabolisa, ngasemwangamwi.
Lakini ganga gapiti ili gaandiki alota baka Sapanga gatimia.” Ndipala banafunzi baki bundeka nukutila.
Yesu palongi ja sengu
Babunkamula Yesu bala bumpelika kunyumba jaka Kayafa, nngolu nkolongu, kobaketangini abola bamalagalaki na aka kilongosi.
Petili ampwata sukutali mbaka paua jaka Nngolu nkolongu. Jajingala nkati jatama pai na alonda ili juwesa kulinga gagiibiya.
Agolu akolongu na sengu joka bataputa malobi gi isoli ili bunkoma Yesu,
lakini ngasebapata malobi gokapai, hata ngati bahikiki bandu bingi babapwaga malobi giisoli. Ndipala pamwisu we baika bandu abeli,
bapwaaga, “Mundu jonzo japwaga, ‘Nhwesa kubombo Nyumba jaka Sapanga nukusenga kabee kwa masoba matato.’ ”
Nngolu nkolongu jajema nukundaluki Yesu, “Boo ngasegubi nu sukupwaga? Boo bandu aba bugutakii ndaba jakikee?”
Lakini Yesu ngasejapwajiki sindo. Nngolu nkolongu ampwagila, “Nugulapisa kwaka Sapanga jojubi mwomi. Utupwajila anaweapa ndi wa Kilisitu Nkombosi Mwana waka Sapanga!”

Yesu japwaaga, “Weapa gupwaga. Lakini numpwagi mwaboti tumbuka sajenu nukuendalee mwambona Mwana waka Mundu jutemi upandi wa malele waka Sapanga jwana makili, jwihika panani ja mahundi gukunani kwaka Sapanga.”
Pajajowana Nngolu nkolongu malobi haga jajendula ingobu jaki nukupwaga, “Jutenda kutondoka. Ngasetupala mundu jongi juhika kuntakila kabee? Mwabee nzowini ejutondwiki.
Boo mwanganya mmbona bole?” Bombi bajibua, “Jubii na makosa kupalika jukomikaje.”
Ndipala buhunila imata kumihu, nukundapu. Bangi babiya bundapu iganza
koni bakapwaga, “Wehapa gu Kilisitu Nkombosi! Lotila nya jojugulapwi?”
Petili ankana Yesu
Petili jabii nkati ja hua. Ntumisi jumu mmbomba anzendila nukumpwagi, “Na wehapa wabii pamu na Yesu mwenei ku Galilaya.”
Lakini Petili jakana palongi jabu jwapwaga, “Ngasemanyiki segumpwaga.”
Ndienu pajapita kunza, kola ntumisi jongi mmbomba ambona, jaapwagila bandu boti bababi pala, “Mundu jonzo jabii pamu na Yesu juku Nazaleti.”
Petili jakana kabee kukulapa, “Ngasenummanyi mundu ajo.”
Monikatae bandu babajemiki pala bunzendila Petili bumpwagila, “Sakaka weapa ndi jumu wabu, ndaba hata kulonge kwaku kubonikana wehapa guhumi ku Galilaya.”
Ndienu petili jatumbuliya kulilobe yaambamba nukulapa sukupwaga, “Ngasenumanyi mundu ajo!” Apalapa likongobi latenda kubeka.
Petili jakombuka malobi gajwapwaga Yesu, “Kabula likongobi ngaselibekiki wingana mala pa tato.” Ndienu japita kunza koni julela ku usungu.
